ERRORS.UNAVAILABLE: Gotchu did not confirm that. Try again in a moment.
ERRORS.UNCONFIGURED: Gotchu is not connected on this desk yet.
ERRORS.INVALID: Gotchu could not accept that. Check the highlighted fields.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This no longer exists. Reload the list.
ERRORS.CHANGED: This changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest.
ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: Only an administrator can change this.
ERRORS.DUPLICATE_SLUG: A procedure with that short name already exists for this store.
ERRORS.NOT_ACTIVE_FOR_AUTO: Only an active procedure can send on its own.

PROCEDURE.AUTO_OFF_NOT_ACTIVE: Only an active procedure can send on its own.
PROCEDURE.AUTO_OFF_UNVERIFIABLE: Auto is off here: this channel can’t prove whose order it is.
PROCEDURE.AUTO_OFF_STORE: Sending on its own is not switched on for this store.
PROCEDURE.AUTO_HINT: Sends on its own after the hold unless someone acts on the draft here or adds the gotchu-manual label. A private note or an assignment does not stop it.
PROCEDURE.KILL_LABEL: To stop it on one conversation, add the label {label}.
PROCEDURE.ADD_PHRASE: + Add a way of saying it
PROCEDURE.REMOVE_PHRASE: Remove this way of saying it
PROCEDURE.BRIEF_HINT: Write it the way you would brief a new colleague. Shop policy still applies and wins over this.
PROCEDURE.OFFER_GOODWILL: Goodwill code, after a person confirms
PROCEDURE.LAST_REPLAY: Would have answered {matched} of the last {considered} conversations.
PROCEDURE.LAST_REPLAY_AMBIGUOUS: Across all procedures, {ambiguous} were too close to call and were left alone.
PROCEDURE.SLUG_HINT: Used in links; can’t change later.

PROCEDURES.TITLE: Procedures
PROCEDURES.LEDE: What Gotchu does for each kind of request. Only a procedure can let it send on its own.

RULE.LIST_LEDE: When something Gotchu already knows is true, tell it what to keep in mind, and hold back sending if it should.
RULE.LIST_NOTE: A rule can only hold sending back. Only a procedure can let Gotchu send on its own.
RULE.BASE_NOTE: Added on top of Gotchu’s own instructions, which you can’t change.
RULE.SENDING_HINT: Can only hold back. Letting Gotchu send on its own is set on a procedure.
RULE.LANGUAGE_NEEDS_NO_CHANGE: Language comes from what the customer wrote, so it can only add text, never hold sending.
RULE.ORDERS_NOTE: “Customer orders” counts only when the order was found by the customer’s own email. A number typed into a chat proves nothing.
RULE.LINE_ITEM_HINT: Words to look for in the product name, variant or SKU, for example gravur, engraving, gravure.
RULE.PROBLEM_DOES_NOTHING: Add something to say, or choose a sending setting.
RULE.PROBLEM_TEXT_DERIVED: Remove the language condition, or set Sending to No change.
RULE.PROBLEM_OUT_OF_RANGE: A number in a condition is outside what that fact can be.
RULE.SAY_HINT: What the agent should always do
RULE.TESTING_NOTE: Goes live only when someone presses Activate.
RULE.CHECKS_NOTE: Checked for promises, customer details and length. These checks catch the common cases, not every one.
RULE.OVERLAP: Overlaps “{title}” (sends on its own on {channel}). Activating this rule, or saving it while it is active, moves that procedure back to Draft until someone raises it again.
RULE.DEMOTED: “{title}” moved back to Draft on {channel}. Raise it again on the procedure when you are ready.
RULE.REPLAY_RESULT: Last 30 days: would have applied to {matched} of {considered} conversations.
RULE.CLASH_BASE: Gotchu base vs your rule. Base wins. A rule can add what to say, never what the agent may do: no sending, no discounts, no refunds, no new actions.
RULE.CLASH_POLICY: Shop policy vs your rule. Policy wins. To change a policy, change it in the Help Center, so there is one place customers and the agent both read.
RULE.CLASH_MEMO: Rule vs memo. The rule wins. A memo is background; a rule is an instruction.
RULE.CLASH_RULES: Two rules. Sending takes the most careful setting of any rule that applies. Every rule’s text applies, the narrowest first.
RULE.CLASH_PROCEDURE: Rule vs the matched procedure. Both apply. The rule adds to the procedure and cannot remove its hand-over steps.
RULE.CLASH_MISSING: Missing facts. A condition Gotchu cannot check counts as not met, and the trace says which one. A rule that holds sending still holds it.
RULE.CLASH_TARGET: A deleted store, inbox or label. The rule is marked “target missing” and never widens to all stores.
RULE.CLASH_AUTO: Sending on its own. Only a procedure can allow it; any matching rule can stop it. A rule that only adds text puts overlapping procedures back to Draft until someone raises them again.
RULE.CLASH_ACCOUNT: Each account’s rules are its own. No rule, memo or condition reads another account’s data.
